votes.motion: A motion was made by Kris Nicholl, seconded by Cyndi Sharkey to approve the Consent Calendar

A motion was made by Kris Nicholl, seconded by Monica Zoltanski to adopt Ordinance #21-23, an ordinance revising Title 21 of the Sandy City Municipal Code chapter 15, "Sensitive Area Overlay Zone" and Chapter 20, "Residential Development Standards", to address concerns with development in sensitive lands areas of the City and to address any deficiencies in the City's regulatory controls and protections over those areas; Also providing a saving clause and effective date for the ordinance

A motion was made by Kris Nicholl, seconded by Cyndi Sharkey to adopt Ordinance #21-24, an ordinance providing for the termination of Ordinance #21-14 (passed in April) which enacted a temporary land use regulation prohibiting development on properties located east of Wasatch Boulevard

A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Brooke Christensen to adopt the timeline and implement the incremental decision making process related to Alta Canyon Sports Center as outlined in Exhibit A (included in the Council packet)
A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Kris Nicholl to table a vote on this item and to request the Chair schedule this item at the next Council Business meeting

A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Monica Zoltanski to adopt Resolution #21-31C, a resolution authorizing the execution of an interlocal cooperation agreement between Sandy City and Alta Canyon Recreation District
